THE ENTIRE APP.overview: The full video library of the ATG ('Knees Over Toes Guy', Ben Patrick) training app: 703 short exercise videos in seven parts. Part 1 covers ATG Dunk, longevity, mobility (gym and home) and physique programs (ATG Muscle, Shred phases, PHA, home shred). Part 2 covers body-part protocols (ankle, elbow, foot, groin, hip, shin, shoulder, wrist). Part 3 covers the main programs (ATG Basics, ATG Pro, Back Ability, Dense Strength, Female Standards). Part 4 covers Knee Ability Pro and Zero and Male Standards. Parts 5 to 7 cover sport programs (distance running, volleyball, soccer, tennis, CrossFit, basketball, jumping, Olympic lifting, speed standards and a young athlete roadmap). Strength and conditioning, not jiu-jitsu technique, but the knee, back and shoulder protocols are popular with grapplers for injury prevention.
THE ENTIRE APP.for: Grapplers wanting joint resilience work (knees, back, shoulders) and general strength.

Power Building Bundle by Jeff Nippard.overview: Jeff Nippard's Powerbuilding programs as documents, no videos: the Powerbuilding 2.0 and 3.0 programs (5-6 days per week), a 'Get Ready' manual, a technique handbook and Excel tracking spreadsheets. Powerbuilding combines powerlifting-style strength work on the squat, bench and deadlift with bodybuilding-style hypertrophy work.
Power Building Bundle by Jeff Nippard.for: Grapplers who want a structured gym program.
